product.title: 5 HTP 100mg - 120 capsules
product.description:
This specialized formulation features 5-Hydroxytryptophan (5-HTP), a naturally occurring amino acid metabolite derived from the seeds of the Griffonia simplicifolia plant. In the human body, 5-HTP serves as the direct metabolic precursor to serotonin. This product is designed with a synergistic blend of cofactors, including Vitamin B6 (in the active Pyridoxal-5-Phosphate form) and Vitamin C, which contribute to the normal functioning of the nervous system and normal psychological function. The formula is further complemented by the addition of Glycine.

Ingrediënten: 1 portie bevat: % RI* Vitamin C (as L-ascorbic acid) 100 mg 125% Vitamin B6 (as 5 mg pyridoxal-5-phosphate) 3 mg 214% 5-hydroxytryptophan (5-HTP) 100 mg ✝ Glycine 300 mg ✝

Dosering: Take 1 capsule daily or as directed by a healthcare practitioner.

Allergenen: Contains no known allergens.

Waarschuwingen: If you are pregnant or lactating, have any health condition or are taking any medication, consult your healthcare practitioner before use. Food supplements are not a substitute for a varied and balanced diet and a healthy lifestyle. Store food supplements out of the reach of small children. Do not exceed the recommended daily intake.

product.description:
What is Mixed Vegetables®?

Mixed Vegetables® contains leafy greens as well as root and cruciferous vegetables. It is a highly concentrated extract of phytonutrients and provides a balance of naturally occurring nutrients. All ingredients are grown in peak season and carefully prepared to preserve freshness and nutritional value.
Plant sterols

Plant sterols (phytosterols, phytosterols) are secondary plant ingredients. They are mainly found in high-fat parts of plants such as oils, nuts and seeds. Phytosterols have a chemical structure that is very similar to cholesterol and have been shown to lower blood cholesterol levels. High cholesterol is a risk factor for developing coronary artery disease.
Vegetable Supplement

This product from NaturesPlus offers an ideal way to supplement the diet with additional vegetables. Each tablet provides a mixture of 4 vegetables.

Bioflavonoids are a large group of bioactive substances that occur naturally in plants. Fruits, vegetables, herbs, nuts, and seeds are particularly good sources. product.title: Vitamin B12 Herbal Lozenges - 30 Lozenges
product.description:
What is vitamin B12? Vitamin B12 (or cobalamin) is one of the water-soluble vitamins and is part of the B vitamin complex, which consists of eight B vitamins. Vitamin B12 is significantly involved in various metabolic processes in the body, including the breakdown of fatty acids. Its central importance for the metabolism of the vitamin folic acid (folate) also makes it important for blood formation. Other examples include support for homocysteine metabolism, contribution to brain and nerve functions, involvement in memory function, and help in reducing fatigue as well as lethargy. It plays an important role in tissue growth and development, not to mention its positive influence on the immune system.

Vitamin B12 in our food Vitamin B12 is found exclusively in animal foods. Under a strict vegan diet, it is therefore easier to develop a vitamin B12 deficiency. In addition, a vitamin B12 deficiency only becomes noticeable after years. The food richest in vitamin B12 is liver. Other food sources include meat, fish, eggs, and dairy products. Vitamin B12 is only contained in plant-based foods if bacterial fermentation has occurred, but then only in very small quantities (bacterial fermentation/fermentation e.g. sauerkraut) that are not sufficient to cover the recommended intake.

Vitamin B12 Herbal Lozenges Vitamin B12 Herbal Lozenges from NaturesPlus contain extracts of dandelion, sarsaparilla, raspberries, and beetroot in addition to 1,000 µg of the activated form methylcobalamin. Hint: Food supplements are not intended to be a substitute for a balanced and varied diet.

product.title: Orange Juice 500 mg Vitamin C - 90 Lozenges
product.description:
What is Orange Juice?
Orange Juice contains 500 mg of vitamin C in orange-flavored lozenges.
Vitamin C
Vitamin C has been proven to have a positive effect on many different places and in various processes of our body.
Vitamin C is the most important water-soluble antioxidant and protects our body from free radicals (aggressive substances that can damage tissues and cells). Known causes of this are smoking, stress and an unhealthy diet. Antioxidants render these free radicals harmless and help the body stay healthy.
Vitamin C also contributes to the normal function of the immune system and the nervous system, increases iron absorption and contributes to normal collagen formation as well as to the normal function of blood vessels, cartilage and skin.
Vitamin C in our diet
Since our body cannot synthesize vitamin C on its own, we have to absorb it completely through food.
Vitamin C sources are mainly fruits and vegetables as well as their juices and smoothies. Citrus fruits, kiwis, berries, strawberries and cabbages in particular are rich in vitamin C.

product.title: Ultra Lipoic™ mini tabs - 60 Mini Tablets
product.description:
What is Ultra Lipoic™?
Ultra Lipoic is a formula that consists of R-Lipoic Acid and Alpha-Lipoic™ Acid. Alpha-lipoic acid comes in two different forms (isomers), the R and S forms. The R-shape is the most natural and effective form of the body. However, the S-form can increase the bioavailability of the R-form. Because of this, this supplement contains a mixture of both forms.
In addition, the product offers a patented probiotic complex, as well as a patented complex with MSM (methylsulfonylmethane), NAC (N-acetyl cysteine), turmeric (standardized curcumin), grape seed extract (from Vitis vinifera, standardized proanthocyanidins).

Alpha Lipoic Acid
Alpha-lipoic acid is a sulfur-containing fatty acid that occurs naturally in the mitochondria of all cells in our body. It can be formed in small quantities in our body from the amino acid cysteine and the fatty acid octanoic acid. Alpha-lipoic acid is also found in limited quantities in our food, especially in animal offal, as well as in vegetables and fruits.

Supplement with Alpha Lipoic Acid
Ultra Lipoic™ by NaturesPlus contains 60 mini tablets per pack.

product.title: ImmunActin® Zinc Lozenges - 60 lozenges
product.description:
What is zinc?
The essential trace element zinc is involved in many processes in the human organism as a component and activator of numerous enzymes. Thus, it helps in the build-up and breakdown of carbohydrates, fats and protein. It also plays a role in growth, the immune system, sexual development and fertility, as well as the sensation of taste and appetite. Zinc is also involved in the antioxidant protection system against free radicals and also supports the bones. It plays a role in mental exertion and activity, as well as in stressful situations. Since there are only limited zinc stores in the body and these can only be mobilized with difficulty in the event of an undersupply, a continuous supply through food is particularly important.

Zinc in our food
Animal products are the main suppliers of zinc. Good sources include beef, pork, poultry, seafood such as crab or lobster, eggs, milk and cheese. In general, zinc can be better absorbed from animal foods than from plant foods. When it comes to plant-based food sources of zinc, cereal products and nuts are in the foreground.

Zinc as a supplement
ImmunActin® Zinc Lozenges from NaturesPlus provides 10 mg of elemental zinc as zinc aspartate in combination with standardized extracts of echinacea, olive leaves and elderberries per lozenge. One package contains 60 cherry-flavored lozenges.
Hint:
Food supplements are not intended to be a substitute for a balanced and varied diet.

Dosering: 1 lozenge three times a day or as recommended by your therapist.

product.description:
What is Acti-Zyme? Acti-Zyme offers a carefully formulated combination of digestive enzymes. It is specially formulated to help the body digest proteins, carbohydrates, and fats. It also contains FOS (fructooligosaccharides) and probiotics.

What are digestive enzymes? Digestive enzymes are proteins that are involved in breaking down nutrients into smaller building blocks in the body. There are many different digestive enzymes – each with a different function. Acti-Zyme contains amylase, lipase, and lactase, among others. Amylase is an enzyme that allows carbohydrates to break down into individual sugar molecules. Lipase helps the body break down fats, as well as lactase helps break down lactose (milk sugar).

product.description:
What is Acti-Zyme? Acti-Zyme offers a carefully formulated combination of digestive enzymes. It is specially formulated to help the body digest proteins, carbohydrates, and fats. It also contains FOS (fructooligosaccharides) and probiotics.

What are digestive enzymes? Digestive enzymes are proteins that are involved in breaking down nutrients into smaller building blocks in the body. There are many different digestive enzymes – each with a different function. Acti-Zyme contains amylase, lipase, and lactase, among others. Amylase is an enzyme that allows carbohydrates to break down into individual sugar molecules. Lipase helps the body break down fats, as well as lactase helps break down lactose (milk sugar).

Bioperine This product contains Bioperine from Piper nigrum, which can increase the bioavailability and effects of numerous substances.

What is Ubiquinol?

Beyond CoQ10™ is a product with a high dose of ubiquinol, the reduced form of coenzyme Q10. A substance that occurs naturally in all cells. Our body can convert coenzyme Q10 into ubiquinol. However, by choosing a supplement with ubiquinol, this conversion step can be skipped.
Ubiquinol in our food

product.description:
What are vitamin C microcrystals? Vitamin C Micro-Crystals contains 5,000 mg of pure crystalline vitamin C powder per teaspoon, without additives. It can be added to juice or sprinkled over food.

Vitamin C Vitamin C has been proven to have a positive effect on many different places and in various processes of our body. Vitamin C is the most important water-soluble antioxidant and protects our body from free radicals (aggressive substances that can damage tissues and cells). Known causes of this are smoking, stress, and an unhealthy diet. Antioxidants render these free radicals harmless and help the body stay healthy. Vitamin C also contributes to the normal function of the immune system and the nervous system, increases iron absorption, and contributes to normal collagen formation as well as to the normal function of blood vessels, cartilage, and skin.

Vitamin C in our diet Since our body cannot synthesize vitamin C on its own, we have to absorb it completely through food. Vitamin C sources are mainly fruits and vegetables as well as their juices and smoothies. Citrus fruits, kiwis, berries, strawberries, and cabbages in particular are rich in vitamin C. Hint: Food supplements are not intended to be a substitute for a balanced and varied diet.

product.description:
What is AgeLoss® Hair Support?
Too much sun, blow-drying, chemical treatments, and poor diet are stressors that can stress the hair and cause it to age faster. AgeLoss® Hair Support provides a combination of nutrients to support hair structure. The ingredients are in extended-release tablets that allow for a long-lasting release of the nutrients.

Strong and shiny
AgeLoss® Hair Support contains zinc and biotin (vitamin B7). These nutrients are known to contribute to normal hair growth and keep hair strong and shiny. In addition, this product provides the antioxidants vitamin C, riboflavin (vitamin B2), and folate (vitamin B9) to protect the healthy cells and tissues in the body from external influences, such as sunlight and air pollution.

Special Ingredients
AgeLoss® Hair Support is enriched with a special combination of bioactive substances and natural extracts. A bamboo extract provides 70% silicon (silica), a mineral that occurs naturally in high concentrations in connective tissue and also in the hair. It also contains an extensive blend of extracts from fruits and vegetables, such as berries, kiwi, citrus fruits, and green leafy vegetables. It also contains the sulphur donor MSM (methylsulfonylmethane), the amino acid L-cysteine, a turmeric extract, and apple polyphenols.

product.title: Super C Complex 500 mg - 90 Capsules
product.description:
What is Super C Complex 500 mg Caps?
Super C Complex capsules contains 500 mg of vitamin C supplemented by the bioflavonoids rutin and hesperdin to improve the absorption of vitamin C.

What is vitamin C?
Vitamin C is the most important water-soluble antioxidant and protects our body from free radicals (aggressive substances that can damage tissues and cells). Known causes of this are smoking, stress and an unhealthy diet. Antioxidants render these free radicals harmless and help the body stay healthy.
Vitamin C has been proven to have a positive effect in many different places and in the most diverse processes of our body:
It contributes to the normal functioning of the immune system, as well as the nervous system, increases iron absorption and contributes to normal collagen formation, as well as to the normal functioning of blood vessels, cartilage and skin.
Vitamin C in our diet
Since our body cannot synthesize vitamin C on its own, we have to absorb it completely through food.
Vitamin C sources are mainly fruits and vegetables as well as their juices and smoothies. Citrus fruits, kiwis, berries, strawberries and cabbages in particular are rich in vitamin C.
Super C Complex 500 mg caps as capsules
Super C Complex 500 mg Caps by NaturesPlus contains 90 or 180 vegetarian capsules.

product.title: Iron - 90 tablets
product.description:
What is iron? Iron is one of the essential trace elements that our body cannot produce on its own. It is involved in many processes in the human organism, including the transport of oxygen as a component of the red blood pigment haemoglobin and the storage of oxygen in the muscles. In addition, iron is necessary for blood formation as well as for the functioning of various enzymes and many metabolic processes. It helps to release energy from fat, carbohydrates, and protein, reduces energy deficiency, and also contributes to normal cell division. Children need iron for brain development. An undersupply of iron can occur, among other things, due to blood loss (menstruation) or phases of increased demand, e.g. pregnancy, children in the growth phase.

Iron in our food Iron is particularly found in animal products such as meat and fish. Animal foods contain divalent iron, which can be better utilized by the body than plant-based, trivalent iron. Nevertheless, plant-based foods such as legumes, whole grains, spinach, peas, and salsify also contribute to meeting iron requirements. Vitamin C can promote the absorption of iron. It is therefore recommended to consume foods rich in vitamin C such as orange juice, peppers, or broccoli at the same time.

Iron as a supplement NaturesPlus' Iron contains 20 mg of bioavailable iron per tablet. One pack provides 90 tablets or 180 tablets. Hint: Food supplements are not intended to be a substitute for a balanced and varied diet.

product.title: Niacin - 90 tablets
product.description:
What is niacin?
Niacin belongs to the group of water-soluble B vitamins. The term niacin does not basically refer to a single vitamin, but stands for nicotinic acid and nicotinamide as well as their compounds. In contrast to many other vitamins, the human body also produces niacin itself: in the liver from the amino acid tryptophan. As a component of important coenzymes, niacin is involved in many reactions in all cells of the body. These include, for example, processes of cell division, the formation and breakdown of carbohydrates, amino acids and fatty acids, and the immune response. Niacin also promotes energy metabolism, contributes to mental resilience, brain and nerve functions, is involved in learning and helps to nourish the skin from the inside out.

Vitamin B3 in the diet
Vitamin B3 is found in meat, fish, whole grains, nuts, seeds, vegetables and potatoes.

Vitamin B3 as a tablet
Niacin from NaturesPlus contains 90 tablets.

That is important
Since niacin stimulates blood circulation, it can temporarily cause a severe but harmless red discoloration of the skin (a so-called flush). Alternatively, niacinamide can be used, which does not trigger this flush.
Hint:
Food supplements are not intended to be a substitute for a balanced and varied diet.

product.title: Esterified Vitamin C - 90 tablets
product.description:
What is Esterified Vitamin C 675 mg?
Esterified vitamin C, i.e. the esterified form of vitamin C, is particularly well tolerated. The ascorbic acid in this product has been bound to palmitic acid as well as to the minerals potassium, magnesium and calcium. For people who cannot tolerate normal vitamin C dosage forms, buffered forms of vitamin C are a suitable alternative because they do not burden the stomach or the rest of the digestive system.
What is vitamin C?
Vitamin C is the most important water-soluble antioxidant and protects our body from free radicals (aggressive substances that can damage tissues and cells). Known causes of this are smoking, stress and an unhealthy diet. Antioxidants render these free radicals harmless and help the body stay healthy.
Vitamin C has been proven to have a positive effect in many different places and in the most diverse processes of our body:
It contributes to the normal functioning of the immune system, as well as the nervous system, increases iron absorption and contributes to normal collagen formation, as well as to the normal functioning of blood vessels, cartilage and skin.
Vitamin C in our diet
Since our body cannot synthesize vitamin C on its own, we have to absorb it completely through food.
Vitamin C sources are mainly fruits and vegetables as well as their juices and smoothies. Citrus fruits, kiwis, berries, strawberries and cabbages in particular are rich in vitamin C.
Esterified Vitamin C 675 mg as a tablet
Esterified Vitamin C provides 675 mg of vitamin C per tablet. One package contains 90 tablets.

product.title: OMNi-BiOTiC® 10 - 30 x 5 g powder
product.description:
OMNi-BiOTiC® 10 contains 5 billion gut bacteria per serving from 10 different strains that occur naturally in the human gut. Scientific studies have shown that the bacteria contained in OMNi-BiOTiC® 10 can settle and multiply in the intestine.

This product is designed to be taken during antibiotic treatment. Antibiotics not only destroy unwanted germs, but also entire strains of ‘good’ intestinal bacteria. This has an impact on our digestion and the colonisation of foreign germs (e.g. Clostridium difficile) in the gut. That is why it is particularly important during antibiotic treatment to supply the body with ‘replenishment’ in the form of bacteria that occur naturally in the human gut, which can also colonise and multiply in the gut.

Ingrediënten: 1 portie bevat: % RI* Bacteria strains Lactobacillus acidophilus W55, Lactobacillus acidophilus W37, Lactobacillus plantarum W1, Bifidobacterium lactis W51, Enterococcus faecium W54, Lactobacillus paracasei W20, Lactobacillus rhamnosus W71, Lactobacillus salivarius W24, Lactobacillus plantarum W62, Bifidobacterium bifidum W23 5 billions CFU ✝

Dosering: During antibiotic treatment: take 1 sachet twice daily. After antibiotic treatment: take 1 sachet once daily for about 14 days after finishing the therapy. Or as directed by a health care practitioner. Mix the sachet into 125 mL of water, wait for at least 1 minute for the product to activate, mix again and then drink. Ideally, there should be an interval of at least one hour between taking OMNi-BiOTiC® 10 and the antibiotic.

Allergenen: Contains no known allergens.

Waarschuwingen: In case of fructose intolerance, you should extend the activation time to 30 minutes. During this time, the bacteria metabolise their food (fructooligosaccharides, inulin, etc) almost completely, so that at most only individual molecules of these substances reach the intestine. Food supplements are not a substitute for a varied and balanced diet and a healthy lifestyle. Store food supplements out of the reach of small children. Do not exceed the recommended daily intake.

product.title: Cal/Mag/Vit D3 with Vitamin K2 - 90 tablets
product.description:
Cal/Mag/Vit. D3/K2 contains the minerals calcium, magnesium and vitamins D3 and K2. Calcium is the most abundant mineral in the human body and performs a variety of tasks. These include the structure and strength of bones and teeth, the transmission of nerve impulses, muscle contraction, blood clotting and wound healing. Magnesium strengthens bones and teeth, relaxes muscles, is important for mental and cardiovascular health, has a positive effect on the cell division process and supports the reduction of tiredness and fatigue. Vitamins D3 and K2 play a role in the formation of new bones and teeth. While vitamin D helps store calcium in the bones, vitamin K can help activate the bone protein osteocalcin.

Every cell needs minerals for its structure and proper functioning. Minerals are of particular importance as electrolytes and as central atoms of enzymes. Together with vitamins, they are crucial building blocks for health.

product.title: Super Selenium - 90 tablets
product.description:
What is selenium?
The chemical element selenium was discovered in 1817 by the Swedish chemist Jöns Jakob Berzelius, who named it after the Greek goddess of the moon, Selene. Selenium is a semi-precious metal and occurs naturally in various organic and inorganic compounds.
The trace element selenium is essential for the body and a component of various enzymes and proteins. It is involved in many reactions in the body, including the regulation of thyroid hormones and the antioxidant protection system against free radicals (glutathione peroxidase). Selenium is also a building block of sperm and supports male fertility. It contributes to normal hair growth and is good for the nails.
Selenium in our food
Selenium is found in many foods, albeit only in small amounts. In particular, the selenium content of plant-based foods is subject to large fluctuations, as it is influenced by the soil. If you follow a vegetarian or vegan diet, you should therefore consciously incorporate plant-based selenium-rich foods such as Brazil nuts and mushrooms into your diet. Good sources of selenium include meat, fish and eggs, as well as cabbage and onion vegetables, lentils, asparagus and nuts.
Selenium as a supplement
The NaturesPlus product contains 200 µg of elemental selenium as L-selenomethionine per tablet. One pack provides 90 tablets.
Important: L-selenomethionine is a special form of organically bound selenium that is well compatible with other nutrients. Unlike other forms of selenium, the absorption of selenomethionine is not negatively affected by vitamin C.
Hint:
Food supplements are not intended to be a substitute for a balanced and varied diet.

product.title: Super C Complex - 60 tablets
product.description:
What is Super C Complex 1,000 mg S/R?
Super C Complex contains 1,000 mg of vitamin C. The product has been supplemented with the bioflavonoids rutin and hesperdin to improve the absorption of vitamin C.
What is vitamin C?
Vitamin C is the most important water-soluble antioxidant and protects our body from free radicals (aggressive substances that can damage tissues and cells). Known causes of this are smoking, stress and an unhealthy diet. Antioxidants render these free radicals harmless and help the body stay healthy.
Vitamin C has been proven to have a positive effect in many different places and in the most diverse processes of our body:
It contributes to the normal functioning of the immune system, as well as the nervous system, increases iron absorption and contributes to normal collagen formation, as well as to the normal functioning of blood vessels, cartilage and skin.
Vitamin C in our diet
Since our body cannot synthesize vitamin C on its own, we have to absorb it completely through food.
Vitamin C sources are mainly fruits and vegetables as well as their juices and smoothies. Citrus fruits, kiwis, berries, strawberries and cabbages in particular are rich in vitamin C.
Super C Complex 1,000 mg S/R as a tablet
Super C Complex 1,000 mg S/R from NaturesPlus contains 60, 90 or 180 delayed-release tablets.

product.title: Zinc 10 mg - 90 tablets
product.description:
What is zinc?
The essential trace element zinc is involved in many processes in the human organism as a component and activator of numerous enzymes. Thus, it helps in the build-up and breakdown of carbohydrates, fats and protein. It also plays a role in growth, the immune system, sexual development and fertility, as well as the sensation of taste and appetite. Zinc is also involved in the antioxidant protection system against free radicals and also supports the bones. It plays a role in mental exertion and activity, as well as in stressful situations. Since there are only limited zinc stores in the body and these can only be mobilized with difficulty in the event of an undersupply, a continuous supply through food is particularly important.
Zinc in our food
Animal products are the main suppliers of zinc. Good sources include beef, pork, poultry, seafood such as crab or lobster, eggs, milk and cheese. In general, zinc can be better absorbed from animal foods than from plant foods. When it comes to plant-based food sources of zinc, cereal products and nuts are in the foreground.
Zinc as a supplement
This product from NaturesPlus provides 10 mg of elemental zinc bound to amino acids per tablet. One package contains 90 tablets.

product.description:
Vitamin C
Vitamin C has been proven to have a positive effect on many different places and in various processes of our body.
Vitamin C is the most important water-soluble antioxidant and protects our body from free radicals (aggressive substances that can damage tissues and cells). Known causes of this are smoking, stress and an unhealthy diet. Antioxidants render these free radicals harmless and help the body stay healthy.
Vitamin C also contributes to the normal function of the immune system and the nervous system, increases iron absorption and contributes to normal collagen formation as well as to the normal function of blood vessels, cartilage and skin.
Vitamin C in our diet
Since our body cannot synthesize vitamin C on its own, we have to absorb it completely through food.
Vitamin C sources are mainly fruits and vegetables as well as their juices and smoothies. Citrus fruits, kiwis, berries, strawberries and cabbages in particular are rich in vitamin C.

product.description:
What is lecithin?
Lecithin is a phospholipid (fat-like substance) that naturally forms an important component of cell membranes in our body. The body makes its own lecithin and, in addition, it can be obtained from various foods. The main sources of lecithin are legumes, nuts, seeds, cereals and egg yolks. Lecithin is also regularly added to a wide variety of products due to its function as an emulsifier, which allows fat and water to be mixed. A supplement is a convenient way to add extra lecithin to the diet.
Lecithin from soy
The lecithin used here is derived from soy (Glycine max). Soybeans are naturally very rich in lecithin. Natures Plus uses only the highest quality soybeans. In addition, this product is completely gluten-free.

OMNi-BiOTiC® WOMAN supplements the bacterial flora with four viable bacterial cultures that occur naturally in the human body. The viability and reproductive capacity of the specially selected bacteria is guaranteed until the best-before date.

The vaginal flora is formed by billions of different beneficial lactobacilli – also known as lactic acid bacteria. These ensure a certain pH value in the vagina, in which unwanted germs and fungi cannot multiply.

However, the natural balance of the vaginal flora can be disrupted. This can be caused by medication (e.g. antibiotics) or hormonal changes (e.g. due to hormonal contraceptives such as the ‘pill’, during pregnancy or menopause). As a result, the number and diversity of the important lactobacilli in the vagina are altered. Consequently, germs and fungi can easily multiply – a microbial imbalance occurs.

product.title: Kelp - 300 tablets
product.description:
What is iodine?
Iodine is one of the essential trace elements that our body cannot produce on its own. It is a component of the thyroid hormone thyroxine and is therefore of central importance for the functioning of the metabolism. All human organ systems (especially the nervous system) depend on iodine. Iodine is also important for maintaining body temperature (basal metabolism) as well as for cell division and growth. In addition, it plays a role in the maintenance of normal skin (regenerative capacity), contributes to normal cognitive function and thus plays an important role in mental movement and activity. It supports normal growth in children. An undersupply of iodine can manifest itself through an enlargement of the thyroid gland as goiter.

Iodine in our food
Good food sources of iodine are sea fish and other marine products such as seaweed and seaweed. The iodine content of foodstuffs is subject to large regional and seasonal fluctuations, as it is largely dependent on the iodine content of soils, water bodies and livestock.

Iodine as a supplement
The product Kelp by NaturesPlus contains 150 µg of natural iodine from Icelandic seaweed per tablet. One pack provides 300 tablets.

product.title: Immune Vitamin C - 100 chewables
product.description:
What is Immune Vitamin C? Immune Vitamin C contains 500 mg of vitamin C along with a bioflavonoid complex in citrus-flavored lozenges.

Vitamin C Vitamin C has been proven to have a positive effect on many different places and in various processes of our body. Vitamin C is the most important water-soluble antioxidant and protects our body from free radicals (aggressive substances that can damage tissues and cells). Known causes of this are smoking, stress and an unhealthy diet. Antioxidants render these free radicals harmless and help the body stay healthy. Vitamin C also contributes to the normal function of the immune system and the nervous system, increases iron absorption and contributes to normal collagen formation as well as to the normal function of blood vessels, cartilage and skin.

Vitamin C in our diet Since our body cannot synthesize vitamin C on its own, we have to absorb it completely through food. Vitamin C sources are mainly fruits and vegetables as well as their juices and smoothies. Citrus fruits, kiwis, berries, strawberries and cabbages in particular are rich in vitamin C. product.title: Vitamin C with Rose Hips - 60 tablets
product.description:
What is Vitamin C 1000 mg?
Vitamin C 1000 mg contains vitamin C in combination with rose hips, which increase the bioavailability of vitamin C in delayed-release tablets.
Vitamin C
Vitamin C has been proven to have a positive effect on many different places and in various processes of our body.
Vitamin C is the most important water-soluble antioxidant and protects our body from free radicals (aggressive substances that can damage tissues and cells). Known causes of this are smoking, stress, and an unhealthy diet. Antioxidants render these free radicals harmless and help the body stay healthy.
Vitamin C also contributes to the normal function of the immune system and the nervous system, increases iron absorption, and contributes to normal collagen formation, as well as to the normal function of blood vessels, cartilage, and skin.
Vitamin C in our diet
Since our body cannot synthesize vitamin C on its own, we have to absorb it completely through food.
Vitamin C sources are mainly fruits and vegetables, as well as their juices and smoothies. Citrus fruits, kiwis, berries, strawberries, and cabbages in particular are rich in vitamin C.

GI Natural™ ProBiotic Women provides 60 billion viable probiotic bacteria from scientifically tested probiotics that have been shown in studies to promote female reproductive health. This uniquely formulated probiotic for women promotes the health of the gastrointestinal tract and the entire body. In addition, Probiotic Women contains a prebiotic fiber complex. The GI Natural probiotics do not need to be stored in the refrigerator as they are stable at room temperature. Hint: Food supplements are not intended to be a substitute for a balanced and varied diet.

product.title: Power Pak Acai Berry - 30 x 5.2 g powder
product.description:
Power Pak
is the perfect drink for active people and endurance athletes. Each sachet provides 1,200 mg of vitamin C and ConcenTrace, the well-known trace element concentrate with 72 different electrolytes. They are perfect for the water bottle during training or immediately afterwards. Or at every opportunity as a thirst quencher.
Tip: For training, dissolve the contents of 1 or 2 sachets in water in a 500 ml drinking bottle. In case of high fluid loss, add more ConcenTrace drops if necessary.
Electrolytes such as potassium and magnesium transmit electrical impulses in the body and regulate the acid-base ratio. They are therefore necessary to keep the body's fluids in balance. This is the best way to call up energy in order to perform. A deficiency of one or more electrolytes can lead to sluggishness, fatigue, decreased performance, and cramps.
Vitamin C is the most important water-soluble antioxidant. Antioxidants neutralize so-called free radicals, which are produced more frequently during physical exertion.
Power Paks contain no artificial flavors, caffeine, or other stimulants.
Hint:
Food supplements are not intended to be a substitute for a balanced and varied diet.

product.title: Animal Parade® Vitamin C - 90 chewables
product.description:
Animal Parade Vitamin® C
contains 125 mg of vitamin C especially for children.
Children need a healthy diet to grow, develop well and perform well in school. Providing your children with the right nutrients in sufficient and balanced quantities is not always easy. Some children are poor eaters or prefer sweets and pizza to healthy fruits and vegetables.
Vitamin C contributes to the maintenance of strong bones and is important for the formation of collagen, which plays a role in the skin and in the normal function of the gums. Vitamin C supports cognitive performance and improves resistance during and after physical exertion.Animal Parade delivers the quality that parents expect and the taste that children like.
Hint:
Food supplements are not intended to be a substitute for a balanced and varied diet.

Ingrediënten: 1 portie bevat: % RI* Vitamin C (as ascorbic acid) 250 mg 312% Bioflavonoid complex from Citrus limon exocarp 50 mg ✝

Dosering: Take 2 lozenges daily or as recommended by your therapist. For children from 4 years old, but also suitable for younger children who can already suck independently.

Allergenen: Contains no known allergens

Waarschuwingen: Food supplements are not a substitute for a varied and balanced diet and a healthy lifestyle. Store food supplements out of the reach of small children. Do not exceed the recommended daily intake.

Bewaren: Store closed at room temperature.

product.description:
OMNi-BiOTiC® Pro-VI 5
is your partner for the immune system: The innovative and globally unique combination of 5 specially selected bacterial strains supplements your intestinal flora with 5 billion symbionts naturally occurring in the human intestine every time you take it.

The use of OMNi-BiOTiC® Pro-Vi 5 is always recommended when the body's defenses are stressed.
